name: ids-are-named-in-the-order-they-are-printed

steps.command: ws-git commit -m one > /dev/null && ws-git log --all -n 1 && ws-git show HEAD
steps.stdout:
<c1> ws-git.restore
commit <c2*>

    one

diff --git a/a.txt b/a.txt
--- a/a.txt
+++ b/a.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+one

summary: A short id and a different whole id first printed in one output are named in the order they appear.
